changelog.title: What's new?
changelog.subtitle: Follow along as Metis evolves. Every version brings real improvements — no promises, just shipped work.
changelog.footer_part1: Metis is in pre-release — bugs are part of the deal. Found something?

p_0_9_24.label: Better item and build recommendations
p_0_9_24.entry_0: Metis now recommends the best items per champion and role, based on thousands of high-elo matches — not guesswork.
p_0_9_24.entry_1: Fairer item ranking: an item with few matches no longer inflates to the top, and you can now see a confidence score for each recommendation.
p_0_9_24.entry_2: Builds stopped repeating the same item in the same role and now treat base items correctly as components.
p_0_9_24.entry_3: We removed items that left the game from builds and rankings, and fixed item images that weren't loading.

p_0_9_23.label: The Metis chat got a lot smarter
p_0_9_23.entry_0: The chat now answers based on real champion guides — knowledge from experienced players, not generic replies.
p_0_9_23.entry_1: Metis knows when it doesn't know: if we don't have an in-depth guide for a champion yet, it says so instead of making things up.
p_0_9_23.entry_2: Sharper answers: Metis understands which champion you're asking about and reformulates your question behind the scenes to find the best answer.
p_0_9_23.entry_3: Metis replies in the site's language (PT/EN) and now factors in the meta and recent patch changes to champions and items.

p_0_9_22.label: More readable recommendation radar
p_0_9_22.entry_0: Recommendation radar: the champion's ideal profile now appears dashed (used to blend with your filled profile). Your profile got vertex dots for clarity.
p_0_9_22.entry_1: Hover any axis to see a tooltip with your profile value vs the champion's ideal.
p_0_9_22.entry_2: New: click an axis to open the "How to improve [axis]" card (personalized AI drills coming soon for Premium).

p_0_9_21.label: New sign-in / sign-up screen
p_0_9_21.entry_0: Sign in, sign up and password reset redesigned in the new Metis look. "Forgot password" mode sends a reset link via email.
p_0_9_21.entry_1: Google and GitHub buttons visible (integration coming soon). Show/hide password via the eye icon.
p_0_9_21.entry_2: On sign-up, password requirements show in real time (8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 digit).

p_0_9_20.label: New screen: My Account
p_0_9_20.entry_0: New /account route with everything about your account — current plan, Metis Chat usage this month, active coupons and watched players in one place.
p_0_9_20.entry_1: Preferences on the same screen: language, accent color and default search region.
p_0_9_20.entry_2: Security section with change password (via email), sign out all devices and delete account.
p_0_9_20.entry_3: Coupons now have a copy-code button and a countdown to expiration.

p_0_9_19_1.label: Avatar menu in the header
p_0_9_19_1.entry_0: Clicking your initial in the header corner now opens a menu: My account, Admin panel (if admin) and Sign out.
p_0_9_19_1.entry_1: PT/EN translation was broken in production — fixed.

p_0_9_19.label: English across 100% of the site
p_0_9_19.entry_0: Every screen now responds to your language — not just the home, admin and header. Tier list, profile, match page, chat, plans, everything.
p_0_9_19.entry_1: Numbers format differently per language: 1.234 in Portuguese, 1,234 in English.

p_0_9_18.label: Site in English 🇺🇸
p_0_9_18.entry_0: Metis now speaks Portuguese and English. The PT/EN switcher sits in the header next to your account — click and the whole site flips language.
p_0_9_18.entry_1: Your preference is saved in a cookie and persists after you close the browser.
p_0_9_18.entry_2: First batch of translated screens: Home, Admin panel and the header itself. The rest landed in the next version.

p_0_9_17.label: Fairer tier list
p_0_9_17.entry_0: We rethought how tiers are calculated. It used to be raw winrate — now it uses standard deviation. A champion only reaches S+ if it's significantly above the role average on that patch.
p_0_9_17.entry_1: Niche picks like Volibear jungle now show up even with few games, if the performance is consistently high on that role.

p_0_9_16.label: Admin panel + avatar bugfix
p_0_9_16.entry_0: Admin panel got the same look as the rest of the site — KPI cards, charts and an invalidate-cache button.
p_0_9_16.entry_1: Clicking your initial in the header was taking everyone to the admin panel. Now it only does that for actual admins.

p_0_9_15.label: Match detail
p_0_9_15.entry_0: Full redesign of the individual match page with 3 tabs: Overview, Team Analysis and Builds & Runes.
p_0_9_15.entry_1: Per-metric comparison between the two teams via a split donut — who got more kills, more gold, more damage, more vision.
p_0_9_15.entry_2: Each player gets their Metis Score highlighted, and the full builds (items, runes, summoner spells) are grouped by role.
p_0_9_15.entry_3: Match timeline reused from the player page — CS/m, gold and XP over time.

p_0_9_14.label: Champion page
p_0_9_14.entry_0: Fresh look for each champion's page with 4 sub-tabs: Overview (stats + power curve), Builds, Matchups and Synergies.
p_0_9_14.entry_1: Automatic unpopular-role detection — if you filter Diana support, the site warns you the sample may not be representative.

p_0_9_13.label: Player profile redesigned
p_0_9_13.entry_0: Player banner with PFP, rank, mastery and a watch button. The first thing you see is who the summoner is.
p_0_9_13.entry_1: 4 large KPIs (winrate, KDA, CS/min and vision score) with semantic colors based on performance.
p_0_9_13.entry_2: Cumulative winrate chart over recent matches — see the player's trend in real time.
p_0_9_13.entry_3: Champion recommendations with an 8-dimension Neo-Artemis radar comparing your profile to the suggested champion.
p_0_9_13.entry_4: Tighter match history with clickable match cards that lead to the detail page.
p_0_9_13.entry_5: Rich sidebar: roles played, play profile, players you play with most, your nemesis and a chat CTA.

p_0_9_12.label: Metis Chat redesigned
p_0_9_12.entry_0: Chat got the site's new look: token bar up top, cleaner bubbles, quick prompts to get started, and a more elegant premium gate.
p_0_9_12.entry_1: Easter egg: a coupon code is hidden somewhere on the site — find it to unlock Premium.

p_0_9_11.label: Meet the team
p_0_9_11.entry_0: New /team page showing who builds Metis — 3 cards with decorative glow, chip tags and live stats (days building, commits, lines of code, André's Red Bull count).

p_0_9_10.label: New Updates page
p_0_9_10.entry_0: This page you're on got redesigned as a vertical timeline, with colored tags and nodes marking each release.

p_0_9_9.label: Redesign: Plans + Coupons
p_0_9_9.entry_0: Full redesign of the Plans page with 4 tier cards, monthly/yearly toggle and new trust footer.
p_0_9_9.entry_1: Coupons feature — dedicated DB table with validity and effect, public endpoint, and "Available coupons" section on pricing.
p_0_9_9.entry_2: First live coupon: MESTRE2604 unlocks Premium with 10k tokens/day until the end of April.
p_0_9_9.entry_3: Comparison table, FAQ and Teams & Companies card now use the new design system.

p_0_9_8_1.label: Backend: Enriched item catalog
p_0_9_8_1.entry_0: `items` table in Supabase — name, gold, tags, category, trend in dedicated columns.
p_0_9_8_1.entry_1: Items endpoint returns gold cost, tags, and room for a curated category.
p_0_9_8_1.entry_2: Items page gained Category + Cost + Trend columns and tag chips next to the name.

p_0_9_8.label: Redesign: Items
p_0_9_8.entry_0: Items page redesigned with 2 spotlights (most bought / top winrate) and a dense table.
p_0_9_8.entry_1: Role, patch, search and sort filters preserved and restyled.

p_0_9_7.label: Redesign: Tier List
p_0_9_7.entry_0: Tier List reimagined as tier-grouped cards (S+ → C) with large portrait, colored WR and KDA/Ban/Games grid.
p_0_9_7.entry_1: Rank, role, patch range and search filters unified in one card.

p_0_9_6.label: Redesign: Home + Design System
p_0_9_6.entry_0: New home: hero with gold/cyan glow, top-3 meta spotlight, top-8 tier snippet with role filter.
p_0_9_6.entry_1: Real Sign in button in the header + avatar when logged in.
p_0_9_6.entry_2: Official Riot role icons on the role badges.
p_0_9_6.entry_3: Light mode removed — the new design is dark-only with customizable accent.
p_0_9_6.entry_4: Hover states back across buttons, cards and rows in the redesign.

p_0_9_5.label: Redesign: Foundation
p_0_9_5.entry_0: Foundation of the new design system — 18 primitives, new palette with LoL gold accent, Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono fonts.

p_0_9_4.entry_0: Mobafire guide scraper storing raw HTML in Cloudflare R2 — foundation for future semantic analysis.
p_0_9_4.entry_1: Scraper bug that returned empty for every champion has been fixed.

p_0_9_3.entry_0: Admin panel got an "Update Tier List" button to clear the 24h cache.
p_0_9_3.entry_1: Tier list now filters unpopular picks by default — toggle to see all.

p_0_9_2.entry_0: Real pickrate and banrate on the tier list, with bans parsed from the match JSON.

p_0_9_0.label: Big Update · Metis Chat
p_0_9_0.entry_0: Pre-release 0.9.0 focused on Metis Chat quality.
p_0_9_0.entry_1: Topic guardrail — Metis now answers ONLY about League of Legends and rejects off-topic questions.
p_0_9_0.entry_2: Defined personality: calm, analytical, never toxic. Turns defeats into lessons.
p_0_9_0.entry_3: Daily token limit per plan — Donor (5k), Premium (30k), Pro (100k).
p_0_9_0.entry_4: Token usage bar in the chat — see how much of your limit you've used in real time.
p_0_9_0.entry_5: Chat upgraded to Gemini 2.5 Flash — a more capable model with sharper answers.

alpha_v0_8_2.label: Security Update
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_0: Full security update — every endpoint now requires internal authentication.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_1: Internal API Key (X-API-Key) protects the whole API — unauthenticated access returns 403.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_2: Sanitized error messages — internal details no longer leak to the client.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_3: CORS restricted to specific methods and headers.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_4: Gemini key configured securely — never stored in logs.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_5: .gitignore blocks .env*, *.key and *.pem — impossible to commit secrets by accident.

alpha_v0_8_1.entry_0: Champion recommendations now use 8 dimensions (Neo-Artemis model).
alpha_v0_8_1.entry_1: More realistic scores — formula combines cosine with Euclidean distance.
alpha_v0_8_1.entry_2: Radar chart in the recommendation details — see your profile vs the champion.
alpha_v0_8_1.entry_3: Full rune map with correct icons on the Build tab.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q_0: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a_0: Yes — no penalty, no paperwork. Cancel directly from your account panel.
faq.a_1: You go back to the Free plan. Your data isn't deleted — only the premium perks stop.
faq.q_2: How does the AI Chat work?
faq.a_2: Metis analyzes your match data and answers tactical questions using Gemini 2.5 Flash with RAG over real game data.
faq.a_3: Yes. We accept PIX, credit card and boleto.
faq.q_4: What does the Donor plan help with?
faq.a_4: It helps keep the servers running and development active. You get extra perks as a thank-you.
